RESULT [labelnoise]: mAP@0.5 improved from 0.607 to 0.696 on Crop and Weed, 0.595 to 0.682 on WeedCrop, 0.598 to 0.683 on 3LC Cotton and 0.592 to 0.678 on WeedMaize. US [labelnoise]: This is the closest domain match (weeds, YOLO, a cotton-weed set) and supports data-side fixes for our edge-constrained laser robot.
